$comment: Placement cases for the feature-sliced-design skill. See README.md in this directory for how to run them. Every `source` path is checked by .github/scripts/validate-skills.mjs.

cases.prompt: Where do I put the auth token and session helpers?
cases.expect: shared/auth/ (or shared/api/). Not a user entity.
cases.why: Tokens and session DTOs are infrastructure, not a domain model, and are rarely reused outside authentication.
cases.rule: Section 2, Step 2; Section 6 anti-pattern on the user entity

cases.prompt: I am starting a project with two pages. Should I create the entities and features layers now?
cases.expect: No. app/ + pages/ + shared/ is valid FSD. Add layers when reuse is real.
cases.why: This is the single most reported community complaint: small projects split into every layer up front.

cases.prompt: getUserById just wraps GET /users/:id and every page calls it. Does it belong in entities/user/api/?
cases.expect: No. shared/api/. Reuse alone does not promote a request; domain rules do.
cases.why: Guards the two-question placement rule. The old bullet list sent this exact function to entities.

cases.prompt: Dashboard stats are fetched only on the dashboard page. Where does the request go?
cases.expect: pages/dashboard/api/. It stays with its only consumer.
cases.why: Question 1 must be asked before Question 2, or pages-first breaks.

cases.prompt: features/profile needs something from features/auth. Is that allowed?
cases.expect: Prefer strategies A to C. If truly unavoidable, only through the other slice's public API, never its internals.
cases.why: The MUST rule reads as an absolute ban; the documented escape hatch must stay reachable.

cases.prompt: Should I add a widgets layer to this new project?
cases.expect: Discouraged. Screen-specific composition stays in pages, reused actions go to features, context-free UI to shared, app-wide layout to app.
cases.why: Must be presented as the official position, not as this skill's preference.

cases.prompt: Can I keep all my entity types in model/types.ts?
cases.expect: No. Use domain-based names such as model/user.ts and model/order.ts.

cases.prompt: How do I import the Button from the shared UI kit?
cases.expect: @/shared/ui/Button, the component folder's own index. Not @/shared/ui/Button/Button.tsx.
cases.why: Per-component public APIs in shared/ui and shared/lib are permitted; reaching past the index is not.

cases.expect: No. A product rule computed over domain data belongs in entities/user/lib/ or higher.
cases.why: The positive half of the business-logic test.

cases.prompt: Can the company logo component and an autocomplete input live in shared/ui?
cases.expect: Yes. Business-themed code and UI logic are both allowed in shared; only business logic is excluded.
cases.why: The negative half of the same test. An agent that over-applies Rule 4-5 fails this one.

cases.prompt: Set up an FSD structure for a shop with a home page, a product page, and a search page.
cases.expect: app/, pages/ with three slices, shared/. No entities or features. Product DTO and requests in shared/api.
cases.why: The finished-structure reflex. Fails if any layer beyond three appears unprompted.

cases.prompt: Two pages each compute whether a product is on sale, and one copy is now out of date. What should change?
cases.expect: Move the rule to entities/product/model. Leave the ProductDTO in shared/api and the badge UI in the pages.
cases.why: Reuse alone did not open entities; a rule that must agree with itself does. Also checks that the DTO does not follow the rule into the entity.

cases.prompt: New project. Where does the app-wide header with navigation and the user menu go?
cases.expect: app/, as an application-level layout. Not a new widgets/ slice. A section used by one page stays in that page.
cases.why: The header is the textbook widgets example. Placement is decided by scope, and the skill discourages opening widgets for it.
cases.rule: Where should layouts be placed?; SKILL.md Section 1 widgets callout

cases.prompt: Should I create src/assets/ to hold all the images and icons?
cases.expect: No. Keep an asset next to the slice that uses it. App-wide icons go to shared/ui, global fonts and styles to app/, bundler-served files to public/.
cases.why: A type-based assets folder is the common default and the official guidance calls it not recommended.

cases.prompt: Next.js App Router project. Where does the FSD app layer go, and what is it called?
cases.expect: src/_app/, with src/_pages/ for the pages layer. The Next.js app/ routing folder stays at the project root and only re-exports from FSD pages.
cases.why: An older pattern kept the FSD layers unprefixed under src/ and moved the routing folder instead. Both existed in the wild.
cases.rule: Next.js; Projects on the previously recommended pattern

cases.prompt: Our FSD 2.0 project has a widgets layer. We are moving to 2.1. What happens to it?
cases.expect: Nothing has to. Widgets is discouraged for new adoption, not deprecated, so an existing layer stays valid and keeps working; only processes/ is deprecated in 2.1. If the team chooses to align, route each widget by responsibility: one-page use inlines into that page, a reused action goes to features, context-free UI to shared/ui, the app shell to app, a composition of features to the page or route layout.
cases.why: Discouraged is not deprecated, and the guide calls this migration optional. The reader most likely arrived from 2.0 already using widgets.
cases.rule: Phasing out a small widgets layer (optional); SKILL.md Section 1 widgets callout

cases.prompt: In entities/todo/model/todo.ts I am writing selectTodos. RootState is exported from app/providers/store.ts. How do I type the selector?
cases.expect: Type it against only the state it reads, e.g. (state: { todos: TodoState }) => state.todos.items. Must not import RootState from app/: entities cannot depend on a higher layer. Type against RootState at the app layer if that guarantee is needed.
cases.why: 6ffafa5 fixed this exact mistake in the skill's own example. Every Redux tutorial types selectors with RootState, so an agent will reach for it unless the rule is concrete.
cases.rule: Business-entity slice in entities; SKILL.md Rule 4-1
